name: Bhagaban Jayasingh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Bhagaban Jayasingh writes poetry in Odia and English and works as a critic, editor and translator. His Odia collection Pheranti Ghar received the Odisha Sahitya Akademi award. Through anthologies such as Footprints of Fire and The Birds in the Storm, he has also brought modern Odia poetry to readers in English.

His poems in Kabita Live approach death through the lives that continue around an absence. In “Grandmother”, a child’s explanations of mortality cannot ease a widow’s grief. In “ଜଣେ କବିଙ୍କ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ”, the world carries on after a poet’s death, while remembrance itself becomes uncertain. The domestic and the cosmic meet in these questions of what remains when someone is gone.
